title: Install or update a package with nala
summary: Use nala to install a new program or update an existing one to the latest version. Nala provides clearer output than standard apt commands.

steps.explain: Install the specified package. If the package is already installed, this updates it to the latest available version.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the package to install or update

rollback.explain: Remove the package if you no longer need it.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the package to remove
